records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The local variable `result` is annotated as a union of the message types but reuses the same name for both StatusChangeMessage and IssueOccurrence branches, and the `result is not None` check in process_detectors now gates on a value that is always non-None on the occurrence path. Future readers/consumers conflating `result.result` (payload) with the evaluation result container get a subtle trap: the previous `result = None` sentinel meaning 'no payload' was removed, so any caller that previously distinguished 'no result' from 'status change' by None-ness now treats every non-OK transition as an occurrence-producing result, changing which paths reach create_issue_occurrence_from_result.

records.issue_text: [BUG] MetricAlertDetectorHandler is declared as a subclass of StatefulDetectorHandler without implementing any of the abstract methods (get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, build_occurrence_and_event_data), so instantiating it raises TypeError; its previous concrete evaluate stub is deleted. Any detector whose type slug resolves to the metric-alert group type will crash the handler constructor in detector.detector_handler / process_detectors with 'Can't instantiate abstract class ... with abstract methods', so every data packet for that detector fails instead of being evaluated (previously it evaluated to no results via the []). The new abstract build_occurrence_and_event_data added in this diff makes the missing implementation load-bearing.
